description: The cervical or lumbar radiculopathy severity ranking, scored the way the Pro Workspace Radiculopathy tile scores it, from the 2012 NYS Impairment Guidelines tables as calc-core carries them: imaging 16, EMG 6, muscle weakness by grade (0–1: 20, 2: 18, 3: 6, 4–5: 0) plus atrophy 6 under the root's weakness cap, sensory (compromised 4, anesthesia 6) under the root's sensory cap, reflex (diminished 4, absent 6), tension signs 4; the letter from Table S11.7. Give the findings (unlisted findings count as normal / no), or instead total_points to rank a total already scored. A total with no row on Table S11.7 (1–3 points, or above the top row) is refused with the reason, never given a letter. Cervical roots C5–T1, lumbar L3–S1. New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core, the same engine as the app and the Pro Workspace; it never estimates. A missing input returns status "missing" and nothing is calculated. Returns the figures, the steps with the rule and engine function behind each, and the not-legal-advice notice.

emg.description: EMG fibrillations / positive sharp waves in 2+ muscles of the root.

imaging.description: Imaging shows nerve-root displacement or encroachment that correlates.

tension_signs.description: Spurling's, straight leg raise or femoral stretch positive.

total_points.description: Instead of the findings: a total already scored, to rank.

name: rank_radiculopathy
title: NY radiculopathy severity rank
